verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant lets users generate queries from natural-language input (honeycomb-docs-4), and its MCP server plus 8-skill agent plugin let AI agents investigate, diagnose, and translate dashboards/alerts into Honeycomb's query language using natural-language interaction (honeycomb-docs-9, honeycomb-docs-10, honeycomb-docs-23, honeycomb-docs-34, honeycomb-docs-35). This covers the core of natural-language operation for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of NLQ accuracy and evidence of natural-language control beyond querying/investigation (e.g., configuring triggers/SLOs via NL).
